name: Inflict Critical Wounds
summary: Deal 4d8 damage plus 1 per caster level (maximum +20) to a touched creature, or heal an undead target for that amount.
description: Channel negative energy into the touched creature. Roll 4d8 and add 1 point per caster level, up to +20. A living target takes that much damage, halved on a successful Will save. An undead target instead regains that many hit points.
